stillair.notes: Maintained hardware/firmware project reference; share tooling, not board designs or purchased stock.

resources.notes: Shared tscircuit authority, checked initial handoff, guarded ECO, native KiCad writes and review gates. Crystal Shim has three requirements-only boards and a tooling fixture; Stillair has legacy production boards and PCB-03 workflow commands.

Shared downstream fabrication checks and exclusion of unreliable Konnect manufacturing output. Crystal Shim defers board-specific profiles until a reviewed board exists; Stillair has released profiles.
Shared state-driven next-step selection; project hardware gates and local document links differ.
Shared learning sweep, state rewrite, commit/push and honest handoff; project data and validation gates differ.
Shared staged multi-file export contract; Crystal Shim uses its standalone tooling smoke fixture, Stillair uses PCB-03.
Shared pinned Bun/TypeScript/tscircuit/export dependencies and Oxc conventions; package identity and board-specific commands differ.
Shared strict TSX compiler settings; include paths match each project.
